title: cross-functional-onboarding-and-career-support-compass-2026
author: Maya Thompson
body:
Overview:
This guide consolidates the operational checklist and people processes that support cross-functional hires (engineering, product, SRE, customer-success, design) through hiring, the first 90 days, and role transitions. It pairs practical tooling steps with the human processes (mentorship, calibration, benefits counseling) so managers and new hires have a single place to follow.

Audience:
- Managers hiring cross-functional contributors
- People Ops partnering on onboarding and promotions
- New hires joining outside of a single-team intake (rotations, platform, solutions)
- HR/Comp partners and hiring managers running role transitions

Goals and targets:
- 90-day onboarding completion rate target: 95% (People Ops metric: onboarding-checklist-completed)
- New-hire time-to-first-merged-PR / shipped-project target: 30 days for engineers, adjusted by role complexity
- Benefits election completion within 21 days of start date
- Role transition cycle time target: 8 weeks (from nomination to effective date)

Quick links (internal):
- Onboarding API: https://internal-api.redwood.local/onboarding
- Access request form: https://okta.redwood.com/app/request-access
- Benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/login
- Career ladder reference: /confluence/company-handbook/02_roles-and-career/competency-maps

First-90-days onboarding flow (step-by-step):
1) Day -7 to 0: Preboarding (Owner: People Ops)
   - Create user identity (Okta) and provision baseline GitHub and JIRA groups.
   - Send welcome packet with manager expectations, team charter, and 90-day milestones.
   - Benefits pre-enrollment link delivered with deadline.

2) Day 0–7: Foundation week (Owner: Manager + Buddy)
   - Setup workstation, VPN, and access to Redwood Console (route: /console).
   - Complete security pledge and basic compliance training (S1).
   - First 1:1 set between manager and new hire; assign buddy and mentor.

3) Days 8–30: Ramp and deliver (Owner: Manager)
   - Complete at least one small scoped task with cross-functional review (code review, product spec, runbook contribution).
   - Weekly onboarding sync with People Ops to track checklist completion.

4) Days 31–90: Ownership and calibration (Owner: Manager + L2/L3 reviewers)
   - Ownership of a customer-facing or internal feature with measurable outcome.
   - Performance checkpoint at day 60 and 90 (see Role Transition Process below).

Onboarding checklist (minimal required items):
- [ ] Okta account + MFA enabled
- [ ] Laptop enrolled in device management (DEP/Intune)
- [ ] GitHub access + team membership
- [ ] JIRA project access and templates imported
- [ ] Redwood Console read access + cost dashboard
- [ ] Benefits enrollment completed
- [ ] Payroll, expense profile configured
- [ ] Security & privacy training completed
- [ ] Assigned buddy and 1:1 calendar series created

Tooling commands and examples:
- Request access via internal API (example curl):
  curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/onboarding/access-requests -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user":"alice@redwood.com","roles":["github:engineers","jira:infra-team"]}'

- YAML snippet for a role-based initial provisioning (used by People Ops automation):
  ---
  user: alice@redwood.com
  start_date: 2026-01-05
  provisioning_groups:
    - github:engineers
    - slack:infra
    - console:readonly

Role transition and promotion process (summary):
1) Nomination (owner: manager) — manager submits packet to People Ops with candidate summary, key deliverables, 90/180 day evidence, rubric mapping.
2) Calibration (owner: People Ops + peer calibration council) — cross-team calibration meeting; reviewers include 2 peers and 1 manager at next level.
3) Business & Comp review (owner: Finance-Comp) — validate level banding and comp impact.
4) Decision & timeline (owner: People Ops) — communicate outcomes and effective date.

- Expected artifacts for a promotion packet:
  - Summary of impact (250–500 words)
  - 3 concrete work samples (PRs, specs, dashboards)
  - Manager recommendation and suggested leveled title
  - Mentorship & customer feedback (if applicable)

Promotion service-level objectives (SLOs):
- Packet turnaround time: 10 business days from submission to calibration meeting scheduled
- Final decision target: within 6 weeks of nomination

Career ladder quick reference (high level):
- IC1 (Associate) — focused on execution and learning; manager-owned goals
- IC2 (Engineer / PM II) — delivers independently on scoped projects; begins mentoring
- IC3 (Senior) — leads medium projects, outlines designs, and mentors multiple peers
- IC4 (Staff) — cross-team technical/product leadership, drives major initiatives
- IC5+ (Principal/Distinguished) — vision and org-level impact; selective promotion

Benefits & perks navigation (high-touch flow):
- New hires are auto-enrolled in a benefits orientation session in week 1. People Ops runs live Q&A and records a short walkthrough.
- Emergency leave & flexible returnship options: contact people-ops@redwood.com with case ID; handbook section 03_benefits-and-perks details eligible leave durations and pay models.
- Stipends (home office, learning) are requested via the procurement portal (procure.redwood.local) — typical turnaround: 7 business days.

Case study: engineering cross-team rotation (example timeline)
- Week 0: Candidate onboarded as Platform Rotation (3-month assignment)
- Week 3: Joint checkpoint with host manager and home manager; adjust expectations
- Week 8: Deliverable review and potential extension decision

Mentorship and manager playbook (quick steps):
1) Assign a buddy with explicit weekly responsibilities for the first 8 weeks.
2) Define measurable 30/60/90 goals with observable outcomes.
3) Schedule a calibration session with peer reviewers at day 60 to gather external feedback.

Operational ownership and contacts:
- People Ops Onboarding: onboarding@redwood.com (primary)
- IT / Device Enrollment: devices@redwood.com
- Access & SSO: access-team@redwood.com
- Benefits: benefits@redwood.com

Maintenance and revision schedule:
- This doc is reviewed quarterly by People Ops and updated after major policy changes. Next scheduled review: 2026-06-01.

Appendix B — Sample 60-day calibration template (text):
- Context: (one paragraph)
- Key outcomes achieved: (bullets)
- Areas of growth / support needed: (bullets)
- Recommendation (keep/adjust/promotion-nominate): (one line)

Notes and related policies:
- See security training S1 and S2 in security-and-compliance/secure-sdlc for required training modules.
- For regulated hires (customers in financial/healthcare verticals), coordinate with Security & Compliance early; People Ops will flag these hires during offer acceptance.
